scripts.build_check:
near() { p=$1; while [ ! -e "$p" ] && [ "$p" != / ]; do p=$(dirname "$p"); done; printf '%s' "$p"; }
if [ -d "$1" ]; then
  if [ -r "$1" ] && [ -x "$1" ]; then echo source=ok; else echo source=unreadable; fi
  echo "source_real=$(cd "$1" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"
elif [ -e "$1" ]; then echo source=notdir
else a=$(near "$1"); if [ -d "$a" ] && [ -w "$a" ]; then echo source=create; else echo source=nocreate; fi; echo "source_at=$a"; fi
if [ -d "$2" ]; then
  if [ -f "$2/.studio-index.json" ]; then echo index=studio; echo "index_source=$(sed -n 's/^ *"source": *"\(.*\)", *$/\1/p' "$2/.studio-index.json" | head -n 1)"
  elif [ -n "$(ls -A "$2" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo index=foreign
  elif [ -w "$2" ]; then echo index=empty
  else echo index=readonly; fi
  echo "index_real=$(cd "$2" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)"
elif [ -e "$2" ]; then echo index=notdir
else a=$(near "$2"); if [ -d "$a" ] && [ -w "$a" ]; then echo index=create; else echo index=nocreate; fi; echo "index_at=$a"; fi
for p in python3.13 python3.12 python3.11 python3.10 python3; do
  c=$(command -v "$p" 2>/dev/null) || continue
  if "$c" -c 'import sqlite3, sys; sqlite3.connect(":memory:").execute("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t USING fts5(x)"); sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 10) else 1)' 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "python=$c"; echo "python_version=$("$c" -c 'import sys; print("%d.%d" % sys.version_info[:2])')"
    py=$c
echo "platform=$("$py" -c 'import platform, sys; m = platform.machine().lower(); a = {"amd64": "x86_64", "arm64": "aarch64"}.get(m, m); s = "macos" if sys.platform == "darwin" else "linux" if sys.platform.startswith("linux") else sys.platform; print("%s-%s-cp%d%d" % (s, "arm64" if s == "macos" and a == "aarch64" else a, sys.version_info[0], sys.version_info[1]))' 2>/dev/null)"
echo "embeds=$(cd "$HOME/.activate-studio/embed" 2>/dev/null && for d in */ok; do [ -f "$d" ] && printf '%s ' "${d%/ok}"; done)"
echo "readers=$(cd "$HOME/.activate-studio/readers" 2>/dev/null && for d in */ok; do [ -f "$d" ] && printf '%s ' "${d%/ok}"; done)"
    break
  fi
done
m="$HOME/.activate-studio/models/minilm384.gguf"; [ -f "$m" ] && echo "model=$m"
exit 0
scripts.build_run:
s=$1 bin=$2 src=$3 idx=$4 threads=$5 py=$6 model=$7 create=$8 meaning=${9:-} text=${10:-} onnx=${11:-} platform=${12:-} readers=${13:-} depth=${14:-}
uname -n > "$s/host" 2>/dev/null
echo $$ > "$s/pid"
phase() { printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$s/phase"; }
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$s/error"; exit 1; }
trap 'echo $? > "$s/exit"' EXIT
export PATH="$bin:$PATH"
[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="${bin%/*}/lib"
phase prepare
if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
  [ "$create" = 1 ] || fail "$src is not a folder."
  mkdir -p "$src" || fail "$src could not be created."
fi
src=$(cd "$src" && pwd -P) || fail "$src cannot be read."
[ "$src" != / ] || fail "Indexing / is not supported; choose a folder."
# The index folder is written to either way; the check said it can be made.
mkdir -p "$idx" || fail "$idx could not be created."
idx=$(cd "$idx" && pwd -P)
base=${src##*/}; tree="$idx/$base"; stage="$idx/.build"
# rm -rf, opening the folders first where one keeps it out: an index of a
# folder its owner may not write has index folders of that mode.
rmtree() { [ -e "$1" ] || return 0; rm -rf "$1" 2>/dev/null && return 0; chmod u+rwx "$(dirname "$1")" 2>/dev/null; chmod -R u+rwx "$1" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$1"; }
rmtree "$stage"
phase index
dir2index() { "$bin/gufi_dir2index" -n "$threads" -x "$src" "$stage" > "$s/dir2index.log" 2>&1 || fail "gufi_dir2index failed: $(tail -n 3 "$s/dir2index.log" | tr '\n' ' ')"; }
dir2index
# gufi_dir2index gives each index folder the mode of its source folder
# before the folders inside it make theirs, so for a user other than root
# a source folder its owner may not write (0555, say) has what is inside it
# left out, with a "mkdir ... failure" line for each. Those index folders
# are made first and the build is run again; what the index records about
# the source is unchanged.
if grep -q '^mkdir .*/db\.db failure: ' "$s/dir2index.log"; then
  rmtree "$stage"
  find "$src" -type d ! -perm -700 -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' d; do
    find "$d" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -print0 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r -d '' c; do
      if [ -r "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then mkdir -p "$stage/$base${c#"$src"}"; fi
    done
  done
  dir2index
fi
[ -d "$stage/$base" ] || fail "gufi_dir2index wrote no tree at $stage/$base."
# The index folders opened for this user, so the text pass can write in them
# and the tree can be moved; their group and other bits stay the source's.
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || find "$stage/$base" -type d ! -perm -700 -exec chmod u+rwx {} + 2>/dev/null
new="$stage/$base"
# The Studio's ONNX embedding model and its packages for this Python, kept
# in ~/.activate-studio/embed/<version> and installed once: from what the
# Studio sends while the build runs (it keeps <version>.sending touched as
# it goes, and removes it when done), by fetch_embed.py with no network, or
# downloaded here for what it could not send, where this system reaches the
# network. Several builds may install at once; the first to finish keeps
# its copy.
e="$HOME/.activate-studio/embed/$onnx"
onnxready() {
  [ -f "$e/ok" ] && return 0
  while [ -f "$e.sending" ] && [ -n "$(find "$e.sending" -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ]; do sleep 2; done
  t="$e.tmp-$$"; rmtree "$t"
  if "$py" "$s/fetch_embed.py" --deps "$t/deps" --no-readers --model "$t/model" --platform "$platform" --cache "$e.files" > "$s/onnx.log" 2>&1 &&
    PYTHONPATH="$t/deps" "$py" -c 'import numpy, onnxruntime, tokenizers' >> "$s/onnx.log" 2>&1; then
    : > "$t/ok"
    [ -e "$e" ] || mv "$t" "$e"
    [ -f "$e/ok" ] && rmtree "$e.files"
  fi
  rmtree "$t"
  [ -f "$e/ok" ]
}
# The document readers, kept in ~/.activate-studio/readers/<version> and
# installed the same way, before the text pass that needs them.
r="$HOME/.activate-studio/readers/$readers"
readersready() {
  [ -f "$r/ok" ] && return 0
  while [ -f "$r.sending" ] && [ -n "$(find "$r.sending" -mmin -10 2>/dev/null)" ]; do sleep 1; done
  t="$r.tmp-$$"; rmtree "$t"
  if "$py" "$s/fetch_embed.py" --deps "$t/deps" --readers-only --cache "$r.files" > "$s/readers.log" 2>&1 &&
    PYTHONPATH="$t/deps" "$py" -c 'import pypdf' >> "$s/readers.log" 2>&1; then
    : > "$t/ok"
    [ -e "$r" ] || mv "$t" "$r"
    [ -f "$r/ok" ] && rmtree "$r.files"
  fi
  rmtree "$t"
  [ -f "$r/ok" ]
}
fulltext=false vectors=false textwhy= vecwhy=
rm -f "$s/text.json" "$s/embed.json"
[ -n "$py" ] || [ "$depth" = names ] || [ -z "$depth" ] || textwhy="this system has no Python 3.10 or later with SQLite's full-text module"
if [ -n "$py" ] && [ -f "$s/enrich.py" ]; then
  phase extract
  if [ -n "$readers" ] && [ -f "$s/fetch_embed.py" ] && readersready; then
    export PYTHONPATH="$r/deps${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  if "$py" "$s/enrich.py" --kb-root "$src" --index "$new" --extract-cache "$idx/.extract" --report "$s/text.json" $text > "$s/enrich.log" 2>&1; then fulltext=true; else textwhy="the text pass stopped: $(tail -n 1 "$s/enrich.log")"; fi
  if [ "$fulltext" = true ] && [ -x "$bin/gufi_sqlite3" ] && [ -f "$s/embed.py" ]; then
    phase embed
    onnxdir=
    if [ -n "$onnx" ] && [ -f "$s/fetch_embed.py" ] && onnxready; then
      onnxdir=$e
      export PYTHONPATH="$e/deps${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
    fi
    if [ -n "$onnxdir" ] || [ -n "$model" ]; then
      # embed.py takes the ONNX model when it loads, else the GGUF one.
      # shellcheck disable=SC2086
      "$py" "$s/embed.py" --index "$new" ${model:+--model "$model"} ${onnxdir:+--onnx "$onnxdir/model"} --gufi-sqlite3 "$bin/gufi_sqlite3" --cache "$idx/.embed-cache.db" --prune --report "$s/embed.json" $meaning > "$s/embed.log" 2>&1 && vectors=true
      [ "$vectors" = true ] || vecwhy="the embedding pass stopped: $(tail -n 1 "$s/embed.log")"
    else
      vecwhy="the embedding model could not be installed: $(tail -n 1 "$s/onnx.log" 2>/dev/null)"
    fi
  fi
  # The Studio searches the text with gufi_query, whose SQLite must read it.
  if [ "$fulltext" = true ]; then "$bin/gufi_query" -n 1 --max-level 0 -E 'SELECT count(*) FROM words;' "$new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { fulltext=false; textwhy="gufi_query on this system cannot read the text tables"; }; fi
fi
# The index answers whole until here: the new one, text and vectors in it,
# takes its place in one move.
rmtree "$idx/.old"
if [ -d "$tree" ]; then mv "$tree" "$idx/.old"; fi
mv "$new" "$tree" || fail "The new index could not be moved into place."
rmtree "$stage"; rmtree "$idx/.old"
case "$depth" in meaning-*) if [ "$vectors" != true ] && [ -z "$vecwhy" ]; then
  if [ "$fulltext" != true ]; then vecwhy="there is no text to embed"
  elif [ ! -x "$bin/gufi_sqlite3" ]; then vecwhy="there is no gufi_sqlite3 in $bin"
  else vecwhy="there is no embedding model for this Python"; fi
fi ;; esac
phase count
c=$("$bin/gufi_query" -n "$threads" -d '|' -a 1 -I 'CREATE TABLE t (d INT64, f INT64);' -K 'CREATE TABLE agg (d INT64, f INT64);' \
  -E 'INSERT INTO t SELECT count(*), sum(totfiles) FROM vrsummary;' -J 'INSERT INTO agg SELECT * FROM t;' -G 'SELECT sum(d), sum(f) FROM agg;' "$tree" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
dirs=${c%%|*}; files=${c##*|}
case "$dirs" in ''|*[!0-9]*) dirs=0 ;; esac
case "$files" in ''|*[!0-9]*) files=0 ;; esac
# What the index itself holds, whatever the passes reported. A folder
# without the table answers nothing.
sumq() { "$bin/gufi_query" -n "$threads" -E "$1" "$tree" 2>/dev/null | awk '{ n += $1 } END { print n + 0 }'; }
pdfwords=$(sumq "SELECT count(*) FROM words WHERE lower(fname) LIKE '%.pdf';")
pdfvectors=$(sumq "SELECT count(DISTINCT g.fname) FROM gchunks g JOIN gvec_rowids v ON v.rowid = g.cid WHERE lower(g.fname) LIKE '%.pdf';")
vectorrows=$(sumq 'SELECT count(*) FROM gvec_rowids;')
report() { if [ -s "$1" ]; then cat "$1"; else printf null; fi; }
json() { printf '"%s"' "$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr '\n\t' '  ' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g')"; }
{
  printf '{\n  "version": 1,\n  "source": %s,\n  "index": %s,\n  "indexDir": %s,\n' "$(json "$src")" "$(json "$tree")" "$(json "$idx")"
  printf '  "builtAt": %s,\n  "gufiBin": %s,\n' "$(json "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)")" "$(json "$bin")"
  printf '  "directories": %s,\n  "files": %s,\n  "fullText": %s,\n  "vectors": %s,\n' "$dirs" "$files" "$fulltext" "$vectors"
  printf '  "depth": %s,\n  "pdfWords": %s,\n  "pdfVectors": %s,\n  "vectorRows": %s,\n' "$(json "$depth")" "$pdfwords" "$pdfvectors" "$vectorrows"
  printf '  "textWhy": %s,\n  "vectorsWhy": %s,\n  "text": %s,\n  "embed": %s\n}\n' "$(json "$textwhy")" "$(json "$vecwhy")" "$(report "$s/text.json")" "$(report "$s/embed.json")"
} > "$idx/.studio-index.json.tmp" && mv "$idx/.studio-index.json.tmp" "$idx/.studio-index.json"
phase done
exit 0
scripts.build_start:
s="$HOME/.activate-studio/builds/$1"
mkdir -p "$s" || exit 3
printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$s/run.sh"
rm -f "$s/enrich.py" "$s/embed.py" "$s/embed_onnx.py" "$s/fetch_embed.py" "$s/embed_deps.json" "$s/exit" "$s/error" "$s/phase" "$s/pid" "$s/host"
[ -n "$3" ] && printf '%s\n' "$3" > "$s/enrich.py"
[ -n "$4" ] && printf '%s\n' "$4" > "$s/embed.py"
[ -n "$5" ] && printf '%s\n' "$5" > "$s/embed_onnx.py"
[ -n "$6" ] && printf '%s\n' "$6" > "$s/fetch_embed.py"
[ -n "$7" ] && printf '%s\n' "$7" > "$s/embed_deps.json"
if [ -n "$8" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.activate-studio/embed" && touch "$HOME/.activate-studio/embed/$8.sending"; fi
if [ -n "$9" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.activate-studio/readers" && touch "$HOME/.activate-studio/readers/$9.sending"; fi
shift 9
if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  setsid nohup bash "$s/run.sh" "$s" "$@" </dev/null >"$s/log" 2>&1 &
else
  nohup bash "$s/run.sh" "$s" "$@" </dev/null >"$s/log" 2>&1 &
fi
echo started
scripts.build_status:
s="$HOME/.activate-studio/builds/$1"
[ -d "$s" ] || { echo state=missing; exit 0; }
pid=$(cat "$s/pid" 2>/dev/null)
host=$(cat "$s/host" 2>/dev/null)
alive=1
if [ -n "$pid" ] && { [ -z "$host" ] || [ "$host" = "$(uname -n)" ]; } && ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then alive=0; fi
echo "phase=$(cat "$s/phase" 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -f "$s/exit" ]; then
  echo "exit=$(cat "$s/exit")"
  [ -f "$s/error" ] && echo "error=$(head -c 400 "$s/error" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  if [ -f "$2/.studio-index.json" ]; then echo __MANIFEST__; cat "$2/.studio-index.json"; fi
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$alive" = 0 ]; then echo state=gone; echo "log=$(tail -n 3 "$s/log" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"; exit 0; fi
[ "$(cat "$s/phase" 2>/dev/null)" = index ] && echo "dirs=$(find "$2/.build" -name db.db 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
exit 0
scripts.embed_probe:
py=$1
echo "platform=$("$py" -c 'import platform, sys; m = platform.machine().lower(); a = {"amd64": "x86_64", "arm64": "aarch64"}.get(m, m); s = "macos" if sys.platform == "darwin" else "linux" if sys.platform.startswith("linux") else sys.platform; print("%s-%s-cp%d%d" % (s, "arm64" if s == "macos" and a == "aarch64" else a, sys.version_info[0], sys.version_info[1]))' 2>/dev/null)"
echo "embeds=$(cd "$HOME/.activate-studio/embed" 2>/dev/null && for d in */ok; do [ -f "$d" ] && printf '%s ' "${d%/ok}"; done)"
echo "readers=$(cd "$HOME/.activate-studio/readers" 2>/dev/null && for d in */ok; do [ -f "$d" ] && printf '%s ' "${d%/ok}"; done)"
exit 0
